events.description: Eli Stone requests prototype for tomorrow's project
Maya Reed requests cardboard consumables box be moved to loading bay
Prototype visible on table in lab, confirmed present
Nora Vale (teal coat) enters EAST_CORRIDOR via badge credential
Nora Vale enters lab from east corridor, takes prototype, exits through east exit carrying it
Maya Reed at loading bay with cardboard box (consistent with 17:10 request)
Theo Park (blue coat) enters CAFETERIA via badge credential, visible in cafeteria camera
Theo Park claims remained in cafeteria from 18:12, confirmed by visual evidence
Ada Finch (red coat) enters RECEPTION via badge credential, visible in reception camera
Ada Finch claims staffed reception, confirmed by visual evidence
Nora Vale (teal coat) exits EAST_EXIT carrying prototype visible in camera
Prototype transported from east exit to unknown location by Nora Vale
Lab empty except for brown object (no prototype), prototype confirmed missing

assumptions: Nora Vale entered the LAB from EAST_CORRIDOR after entering at 18:10
The prototype was taken during Nora Vale's visit between 18:10-18:14
No one else entered the lab area during this timeframe based on access logs
Service corridor blind spot (V10) was not used - no evidence shows anyone entering via this route

missing_intervals.description: Time between Nora Vale exiting east exit with prototype and discovery of missing prototype in lab
missing_intervals.significance: Prototype was already out of lab by 18:14, so theft occurred before this time

missing_intervals.description: No camera coverage for service corridor (V10 blind spot)
missing_intervals.significance: Cannot rule out unauthorized entry via service corridor without additional evidence

contradictory_timestamps.claim: Only visited east corridor and left
contradictory_timestamps.contradicted_by: V04 shows Nora Vale exiting east exit at 18:14 carrying prototype
contradictory_timestamps.resolution: Visual evidence contradicts witness statement - she did take the prototype
